note: Fourth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, oak beams, round-arched stone doorways, as on the exterior): the hardware and metal shop, with slate-grey brick walls and a grey concrete floor. LANDMARK: the huge black anvil on its tree-stump block under the chain hoist. The arched doorway on the far left shows the mint fashion boutique with its gilded mirror (way back); the arched doorway on the far right shows the emerald jewellery shop (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the high copper shelf (z1).
